tools.name: clawql_sql
tools.description: PRIMARY firm-knowledge tool. Read-only DuckDB SQL (MCP data_query). Tables: matters, matter_documents, open_facts; plus any pre-defined views. Match WHERE to every prompt conjunct (size AND deal-type AND …) — do not drop a noun because it is missing from practice_area enums; map via DESCRIBE / SHOW TABLES to is_*/has_* or a view. For frequency/rate questions: first return the full population N (every id), then the k subset — never k alone. Do not add unstated filters. After rows return, IMMEDIATELY write /workspace/output/response.md from them.

tools.name: clawql_memory_recall
tools.description: Optional AFTER a SQL draft exists. Vault/ontology recall. For second-request tasks only: schema=legal.Matter + filters title contains HSR_SECOND_REQUEST. Do not use as turn-1 exploration instead of clawql_sql.

tools.name: clawql_memory_ingest
tools.description: Persist a finding into the ClawQL vault (optional; never instead of response.md).

tools.name: clawql_search
tools.description: Do NOT use for firm-knowledge LAB tasks. API operation discovery only.

tools.name: clawql_execute
tools.description: Do NOT use for firm-knowledge LAB tasks. API execution only.

tools.name: clawql_audit
tools.description: Do NOT use for firm-knowledge LAB tasks during the agent loop.
